/!\SINCE RIRU V22 YOU MUST ENABLE RESOURCE HOOK IN LSPOSED SETTINGS/!\
Thanks to @Hyper.Alvi for his help !
/!\ SystemUI must be restart to apply modifications (it changes dynamically after)/!\
Officially working with :
OneUI 3.x
AOSP R
